mcpEnabled.label: External AI control (MCP)
mcpEnabled.description: Authenticated loopback MCP for bots in human-led parties.

mcpPort.label: MCP port
mcpPort.description: Loopback HTTP port for external AI clients.

mcpLeaseSeconds.label: External control lease
mcpLeaseSeconds.description: Wall seconds before unattended control returns to ordinary AI.

maxBots.label: Most bots
maxBots.description: Bots at most across the whole server.

townBotsMode.label: Town visitors
townBotsMode.description: Automatic scales each town from Most bots; Custom uses Bots per town (lower or boosted); Organic never backfills towns and only shows bots whose own quests bring them there.

townBots.label: Bots per town (Custom)
townBots.description: Visiting bots kept in a town you are in when Town visitors is set to Custom.

persistenceMode.label: Character lifecycle
persistenceMode.description: Cycling deletes a bot after all campaign quests and lets towns reassign questing bots. Persistent keeps accounts and characters through endgame up to level 100, recovers them from saves if bots.json is missing, and never warps them across acts.

firstSpawnSeconds.label: First bot after
firstSpawnSeconds.description: How long after the Gateway starts the first bot is created.

spawnIntervalSeconds.label: A new bot every
spawnIntervalSeconds.description: How often a new bot is created, while there are fewer than the most.

league.label: League
league.description: The league of the bots' characters.

questMinutes.label: Quest time
questMinutes.description: How long a quest takes, out of sight: a random time in this range.

townActivities.label: Things to do in town
townActivities.description: How many places a staying visit goes to in town.

idleSeconds.label: Time at each place
idleSeconds.description: How long a bot stands at each place in town.

deathChancePerQuest.label: Death chance per quest
deathChancePerQuest.description: A death makes the bot retry the quest.

statusSeconds.label: Status file every
statusSeconds.description: How often data/mods/playerbots/logs/status.txt and data/mods/playerbots/bots.json are rewritten.
